title: Internet completely down
text: Ask if the router is on and which lights show. No lights: check the power cable and wall socket; still dark = ticket hardware_power. Lights on but the internet light is red or orange: a restart (hold power 10 seconds, wait 2 minutes); already tried = ticket line_fault. All lights green but no internet: WiFi or cable? WiFi = WiFi flow; cable = ticket device_or_line_fault. Internet light blinking fast = line_fault ticket; all lights blinking = firmware update, wait 5 minutes.

title: Slow speeds
text: Ask what speed they get versus their plan; if they don't know how to check, point them to a speed test site. Far below plan: WiFi or cable? WiFi and far from the router = range, suggest the mesh extender; WiFi next to the router or cable on all devices = ticket speed_degradation; one device only = that device's settings. Slightly below plan in the evening (7-11 pm) = peak-hour congestion: ask if it is all day (ticket speed_degradation) or evenings only (log congestion). Speed fine but streaming or gaming lags: ask which (streaming = lower 4K quality, gaming = ask game and server, calls = check upload).

title: WiFi issues
text: Ask if it happens on WiFi only or also on a cable. WiFi only: how many rooms from the router? Same room and weak = ask about thick walls, microwaves, other routers (interference: channel change), else ticket wifi_signal_weak. Two or more rooms away = offer the mesh extender add-on or a technician visit. Dropping every few minutes on all devices = ticket wifi_drops; one device = forget and rejoin the network. Network not visible: WiFi light off = press the WiFi button; on = hidden network, connect manually. Cable also bad = internet down or slow speed flow.

title: Can't connect: password or network
text: Ask what happens when they connect. Wrong password = the default WiFi key is on the router sticker; still wrong = it was changed, reset via the router page or a technician ticket. Network shows but won't connect = forget the network and rejoin; still failing = ticket connectivity_auth. Network not showing = WiFi light and button; or try the 2.4 GHz network. Too many devices = the router's device limit; under the limit = ticket connectivity_capacity.

title: Billing and payment
text: Only after their identity is confirmed (registered phone, email or account number). Wrong amount: ask charged vs expected, check add-ons and plan changes, ticket billing_dispute. No invoice: confirm the email on file, ticket invoice_resend. Payment failed but money deducted: ask the method (UPI = UTR number, card = date only, never card numbers), ticket payment_reconciliation, urgent. Change payment method = ticket payment_method_change. Higher bill than usual = check recent plan or add-on changes, ticket billing_query. GST invoice = ask for the GSTIN, ticket gst_invoice_request. Billing date change = ticket billing_date_change.

title: New installation
text: Ask the city and locality first. We serve everywhere: say so, ask the exact address if they only gave a city or country, list the plans with local prices and ask which one; then ask home or business (business: users, static IP, SLA needs). Naming a plan places the order and a technician installs within 48 hours.

title: Plan upgrade or downgrade
text: Say the plan on file and ask which plan they want. Upgrade: explain what the faster plan is good for and its local price; it takes effect from the next billing cycle; ask to confirm, then ticket plan_upgrade. Downgrade: mention it may feel slower for heavy streaming or many users, takes effect next cycle, confirm, ticket plan_downgrade. Unsure which plan: ask how many people, 4K streaming or calls, working from home. No temporary upgrades.

title: Add-on services
text: Ask which add-on. Explain it from the catalogue with its local price and ask to confirm (ticket addon_add). Removing an add-on: confirm which one, removal from the next billing cycle (ticket addon_removal). Pausing for travel: the vacation pause, ask the start date (ticket service_pause).

title: Moving an existing connection
text: Ask if the move is within the same city or to another city, and the new address. We serve everywhere, so: relocation visit (ticket relocation_same_city or relocation_intercity, the relocation service price from the catalogue). Temporary move: suggest a pause instead.

title: Cancellation
text: Say you're sorry and ask what prompted it: an unresolved problem, price, another provider, moving, or temporary. Temporary = suggest the vacation pause. Unresolved problem = offer to escalate it first. Moving to another provider = ask what made them choose it (log the reason). There is no cancellation fee; any balance goes on the final bill. Confirm before opening ticket cancellation_request.

title: Router configuration
text: Ask what they want to change. WiFi name or password: router page at 192.168.1.1, log in with the details on the router sticker, Wireless settings; devices must reconnect after a password change. Router page not opening: connect to the router first, or try 192.168.0.1, else a support ticket. Parental controls: the Family Shield add-on. Consoles and TVs: a cable is best for gaming. Port forwarding: Advanced, Port forwarding, needs the port and the device's local IP. Router restarting by itself: how often (every few hours = ventilation; every 30 minutes = ticket router_rebooting; after power cuts = a UPS). Factory reset wipes the WiFi name and password: confirm first, then hold reset 15 seconds.

title: OTP and account access
text: Ask what happens when they log in. No OTP: it goes to the registered mobile on file, ask if that is the number they're checking; delays of 1-2 minutes and DND filters are common; can send to the registered email instead; a different number = ticket contact_update. Forgot password: the Forgot password link on the login page sends a reset link. Locked after 5 failed attempts: unlocks in 30 minutes, or confirm their registered phone to unlock. App problems: Android or iPhone and app version; latest but crashing = ticket app_bug.

title: Service outage in the area
text: Check the network serving their area. A node is down: tell them there is a known outage in their area and the team is on it, and that they'll get a message when it's back; never promise a fix time unless the outage has one. Nothing down: say there's no reported outage, it may be their line, and continue with the internet down questions.

title: How to test speed
text: Run a speed test site (download, upload and ping), on a cable if possible, with other apps closed, two or three times and take the average. Then ask what speed it shows.

title: Business support
text: Ask if they have an account manager (route to them) or handle as standard but flag as business. SLA claims need the ticket number and downtime duration. Multiple offices: separate accounts or one billing account. A dedicated support line comes with business plans: say which plan they are on and whether it includes it.
